title: Concept: HAProxy statistics report disclosed
description: The HAProxy statistics page names every backend server and shows live session counts, so an anonymous reader learns the internal address plan and the current health of each node. That is reconnaissance that needs no guessing.
applicability: Responses served by HAProxy with the stats page enabled on a reachable listener.
risk: An attacker maps the internal services behind the proxy and times load against the healthy nodes, then uses the health column to see the effect of an attack in real time.
